# MIND (M-Health Index and Navigation Database)

> MIND, the M-Health Index and Navigation Database, is a free library of mental health apps evaluated by trained raters at the Division of Digital Psychiatry at BIDMC. Each app is assessed on cost, privacy, supporting evidence, features and the conditions it supports, using the American Psychiatric Association’s app evaluation framework.

Each app page lists MIND’s evaluation (cost, platforms, supported conditions, privacy, clinical foundation, features, engagement, inputs and outputs, developer type, country availability), the date it was last reviewed, and the rater’s qualitative review when there is one. Store descriptions are quoted from the app stores and are not vetted by MIND. MIND does not endorse apps; ratings describe what each app offers so people and clinicians can choose for themselves.

Pages are also available in French (/fr/…) and German (/de/…).

## Key pages

- [App library](https://mindapps.org/): every evaluated app, searchable and filterable
- [Evaluation framework](https://mindapps.org/FrameworkQuestions): the questions raters answer for each app
- [Suggest an app](https://mindapps.org/SuggestApp): suggest an app for evaluation
- [Sitemap](https://mindapps.org/sitemap.xml)
